subject.title: feat(googlechat): opt-in dmThreadMode to thread DM replies

question: Should Google Chat DM threading be controlled by the existing `replyToMode` thread-routing contract, or should OpenClaw accept a separate `dmThreadMode` account key?
rationale: Both choices are plausible, but adding a new config surface next to `replyToMode` is a product/API decision with compatibility and documentation impact that automation should not settle.

options.title: Extend `replyToMode`
options.body: Use the existing Google Chat threading setting as the single user-facing API for DM and group reply-thread behavior, avoiding a parallel DM-only knob.

options.title: Accept `dmThreadMode`
options.body: Keep the separate opt-in key, but require exported types, generated metadata, docs/help, upgrade notes, and live Google Chat proof before merge.

options.title: Pause for thread-routing work
options.body: Defer or close this branch until the overlapping Google Chat thread-routing PRs settle the canonical reply-target model.

recommendation.title: Extend `replyToMode`
recommendation.body: Use the existing Google Chat threading setting as the single user-facing API for DM and group reply-thread behavior, avoiding a parallel DM-only knob.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest recent history on the prior DM thread suppression and Google Chat thread-reply support paths.
